comparison.title: Article A — The Guardian
comparison.summary: Frames climate change as an existential crisis requiring immediate systemic change. Emphasizes scientific consensus and grassroots activism. Uses emotionally charged language to convey urgency.

comparison.title: Article B — Wall Street Journal
comparison.summary: Frames climate policy through an economic lens, emphasizing market solutions, innovation, and cost-benefit analysis. Skeptical of rapid regulatory changes. Prioritizes economic stability.
